name: Custennin

attributes.attribute: has a small part in the tale of Kulhwch and Olwen
the giant who is father of Olwen

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Custennin is a hero of Welsh tradition. His part in the tale of Kulhwch and Olwen is small. In that tale he is the herdsman of a giant. The giant is named Yspaddaden Penkawr, and he is the father of the maiden Olwen.

okr.objective: Custennin is a hero of Welsh tradition.
key_results: Custennin is a hero of Welsh tradition.
His part in the tale of Kulhwch and Olwen is small.
